notes.title: Divinest Light Original Soundtrack Released.
notes.content:
We are glad to announce that the Original Soundtrack by Alex Krownway is now live on Steam! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38332677/3d94358a84d2c0e03631217ec4f9ad5e85a4c87d.png[/img]

This Soundtrack includes over 30 minutes of quality atmospheric music, some of which did not make it into the final game.

Get the game and soundtrack for the reduced price by purchasing the bundle!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/16883/Divinest_Light__Original_Soundtrack/
